description: Post-hoc threshold sweep in standardized units. Each task's threshold is moved to tau_t + delta*sigma_t; in standardized score z=(score-tau_t)/sigma_t the alarm rule becomes z > delta. A common delta is NOT a common absolute shift (each task has its own sigma_t).
note_0: delta=0 is the stored operating point and must reproduce the formal FPR@fixed / FNR@fixed (the audit verifies this to ~8e-17).
note_1: example_tolerance is an EXAMPLE (FPR<=5% AND FNR<=10%), not an industrial standard.
